contentPattern.structure: solid colored tile + title + description paragraph + arrow link

suitableFor: 'Explore More'-style colored navigation tiles with a title, a short description, and an arrow link
linked promo tiles on solid color backgrounds with body copy (no icon, no image)
notSuitableFor: tiles with only a title and arrow and no description (use cards-platform)
article/insight cards with photographic thumbnails, category tags, and dates (use cards-insights)
